licence: All audio synthesised by video/scripts/make_audio.py; no third-party samples.
loudness_note: lufs = BS.1770 max momentary (400 ms) for SFX and end_hit, integrated for the bed. Clicks (tick, tock, ui_tap, count) start 3 ms into the file.

files.name: whoosh_short
files.description: Airy pass-by for quick cuts, card swipes, text wipes. Peak at ~0.19 s: put that on the cut.

files.name: whoosh_long
files.description: Deeper, slower whoosh for big camera moves and scene transitions. Peak at ~0.54 s.

files.name: tick
files.description: Brand sound: turn-signal relay 'tick' (contact closes). Dry, centre. Place ON the beat; pair with tock half a beat later.

files.name: tock
files.description: Brand sound: turn-signal relay 'tock' (contact opens), lower and duller. Place on the off-beat, 0.341 s after tick.

files.name: pop
files.description: Soft cork-like pop for a card or chip appearing.

files.name: chime_stay
files.description: The 'Stay' answer: calm warm two-note chime, A5 falling a fifth to the tonic D5 (second note at 0.24 s).

files.name: chime_info
files.description: Speed / info callout: brighter single A5 with a quick rising E5 grace note (main note at 0.07 s).

files.name: chime_done
files.description: Trip report / completion: three-note resolved phrase A4-D5-F#5 landing on a D chord (notes at 0, 0.19, 0.38 s).

files.name: impact_soft
files.description: Soft low thud for a title or card landing. Mono.

files.name: sub_hit
files.description: Deep sub hit with a short tail for a section change or logo reveal. Mono; mostly felt on full-range speakers.

files.name: riser
files.description: Filtered-noise + tone riser (D3 to D5), builds to its end at 1.5 s: end it on the cut or on a hit.

files.name: swell_rev
files.description: Reversed D-major swell that ends abruptly at 1.5 s: end it exactly on a cut, then silence or a hit.

files.name: ui_tap
files.description: Tiny fingertip tap for a button press or toggle.

files.name: slide
files.description: Smooth narrow-band slide for the car or marker moving one lane. No pan baked in: pan it in the mix to match direction.

files.name: count
files.description: Very short tick for number count-ups; repeat at most ~20 per second.

files.name: bed
files.description: Music bed under the voice-over: marimba, felt keys, sub bass, light shaker. Starts on beat 1 at t=0; ends on a ringing D chord faded to silence, so it loops on the bar grid or fades anywhere.

files.name: end_hit
files.description: End card: full D major chord with a low hit, rings about 4 s. Put its start on the final downbeat and fade the bed under it.
